shortDescription: Create, update, or delete Kubernetes node pools

options.name: auto_scale
options.description: Enable auto-scaling for the node pool.

options.name: client_override_options
options.description: Client override options (developer use). For example, can be used to override the DigitalOcean API endpoint for an internal test suite. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: The UUID of the Kubernetes cluster.

options.name: count
options.description: The number of Droplet instances in the node pool.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier of the node pool. Used for lookup when updating or deleting.

options.name: labels
options.description: An object of key/value mappings specifying labels to apply to nodes.

options.name: max_nodes
options.description: Maximum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

options.name: min_nodes
options.description: Minimum number of nodes for auto-scaling.

options.name: module_override_options
options.description: Module override options (developer use). Can be used to override module options to support experimental or future options. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the node pool.

options.name: size
options.description: The slug identifier for the size of the nodes.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the resource, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy.

options.name: tags
options.description: An array of tags to apply to the node pool.

options.name: taints
options.description: An array of taints to apply to nodes in the pool.

options.name: token
options.description: DigitalOcean API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value. C(DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN), C(DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN), C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN)
